list: Official 55 trophies as published on PlayStation, cross-checked against the fetched lists in the source registry
sources_note: Official names, descriptions and grades are PlayStation's, as listed by Exophase [S2]. Every guide and every step below is written for this entry in its own words; each step ends with the registry keys of the sources it rests on. Methods come mainly from the PowerPyx trophy guide and roadmap [S1], fetched in full. The hidden/non-hidden split (28 hidden, 27 shown) is the one published by GAMES.GG [S3] and corroborated by Press Start's full list [S4]. Where PowerPyx marks a method 'currently unknown', this guide says so instead of inventing one.
roadmap_note: PowerPyx rates the platinum 4/10 at roughly 200 hours, one playthrough, no mission replay, and cheats disable trophies and saving [S1][S3]. Its one potentially missable trophy is Positive Mental Attitude: the Chapter 1 balcony meditation at Jason's house [S1][S3]. This tracker keeps its wider ⚠ CAUTION list as a safety net — a trophy tied in its official description to one named mission, person, unique animal, choice or single moment is flagged so you bank it early and keep chapter-boundary saves — while the detail panel always says what the fetched sources actually confirm.

sources_differ.detail: The trophy pops at 250 of 397 stunts, but the 100% checklist holds its own line at 300 of 397. Two finish lines from the same source family: stop at 250 only if you are skipping 100% [S1][S10].

The main guide's own link promises '12 Shooting Range Locations', but the fetched range guide puts the 42 golds in 12 challenges at only 2 ranges — Griffin in north-west Vice City and Rodgers Ranch in north-east Port Gellhorn. Trust the sub-page: there are two buildings to visit, not twelve [S1][S6].

The trophy counts 18 meditations but there are only 10 spots: spots 2–9 count twice, once with each character, and the 100% checklist asks for only 15 of 18. Whether the Chapter 1 balcony meditation is strictly required for the trophy is still unconfirmed — PowerPyx says so on both its roadmap and its meditation page, so this guide keeps it flagged ⚠ rather than guessing [S1][S5][S10].

Don't Touch My Deck pops at 3 complete sets; the 100% checklist wants 15 of the 18 sets, which means at least 372 of the 480 unique cards. A finished card hunt for the trophy is barely a fifth of the 100% hunt [S8][S10].

sources_differ.topic: Vehicles — 557 in the game, 277 that count
sources_differ.detail: PowerPyx's trophy guide says GTA VI features 557 vehicles at launch, but the 100% checklist counts only the 277 base models, 200 of which must be scanned. Whip It Good's 100 discoveries can include variants the checklist ignores [S1][S10].

The published WAiNK sets name 31 landmarks + 35 curiosities + 23 sculptures = 89 scans, plus a fourth set PowerPyx still lists as unknown and the No Flusher Tags. The trophy needs any 100, so the balance comes from sets still being catalogued — and only 7 of the 31 landmarks had been published when the list was fetched [S1][S11][S12].

Top Fun pops with one win at each of the 14 locations. The 100% checklist wants all 42 time trials completed — but only the first two races at each location (28 of 42) need their par time beaten; the third just needs finishing [S9][S10].
Earn Cash, Not Kudos pops at 20 different race wins; the 100% checklist raises the bar to 30 of the 40 unique races. Winning every race once overshoots both bars [S1][S10].

trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The platinum itself: it unlocks on its own the moment the other 54 trophies are all earned, so never chase it directly. Use the tracker by grade instead — when Bronze, Silver and Gold all read complete, this one follows automatically. If it ever looks stuck, check the one trophy you filtered out of view, not this one.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase PS5 list [S2], cross-checked against Press Start [S4]. Method: PowerPyx roadmap — earn all other single-player trophies, no multiplayer or DLC required [S1].
steps: Earn the other 54 trophies; the platinum needs nothing of its own [S1]
Work the five roadmap stages in order so the last trophy is a count, not a surprise [S1]
Keep cheats off the whole run — they disable trophies and saving [S1][S3]
When every grade reads complete in this tracker, this one pops by itself [S2]

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Play the opening mission, Gone Fishing, from a new game and finish it to the end — this is the first trophy of the story and it cannot be started late. Treat the mission as your tutorial: learn movement, driving and the partner switch here, because later trophies assume all three. It pops on mission completion, not on any score inside it.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG hidden table [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — automatic story trophy, unlocks after the first main mission in Chapter 1 [S1].
steps: Start a new game and play the first main mission, Gone Fishing, in Chapter 1 [S1]
Finish it to the end — the trophy is automatic and cannot be missed [S1]
No medal, time or score condition applies to any story trophy in this list [S1][S3]
Save manually right after it pops; that save anchors your chapter-boundary set [S3]

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 1 in order. Keep one manual save at the start of the chapter and one at its end: that pair of saves is the cheapest insurance for every chapter trophy in this guide. Side activities can wait — nothing in the chapter asks for a count, a medal or a collectible.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — unlocks after completing the first main mission of Chapter 2, and there is no mission replay, hence the save pair [S1].
steps: Play Chapter 1's missions in order to the chapter's end [S1]
Before leaving Chapter 1, do Lucia's balcony meditation at Jason's house — see Positive Mental Attitude [S1][S3]
Keep a manual save at the chapter's start and another at its end; there is no mission replay [S1][S3]
The trophy unlocks as Chapter 2 opens, after its first main mission [S1]

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 2 in order; the name is shown exactly as PlayStation publishes it, asterisks included. Start stranger strands you meet during this chapter rather than postponing them all to the endgame — several strand-final trophies in Stage 2 grow out of introductions made while the story is still opening the map.
trophies.sources: Official name (asterisks as published) and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 3 [S1].
steps: Play Chapter 2's missions in order, including Coffee Break, which unlocks free-roaming as both characters [S1]
From Coffee Break on, partner trophies and the Scooter Bros and garage unlocks become available [S1]
Keep the chapter start/end save pair — 15 manual slots exist, so there is room [S1][S3]
The trophy unlocks after the first main mission of Chapter 3, Welcome to Vice City [S1]

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 3 in order. By this chapter the activity map is wide open, so set a routine: one story mission, then one activity or collectible sweep in the same district. That rhythm quietly builds the 250 stunts, 100 WAiNK locations and 52 areas that Stage 3 asks for, instead of leaving them as one endgame grind.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — unlocks after the first two main missions of Chapter 4 [S1].
steps: Play Chapter 3's missions in order, including The Cartel Heist and Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs [S1]
Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs unlocks the Snap Gun and jewellery robberies — Sneakthief opens up here [S1]
Alternate one story mission with one district sweep of stunts, scans and areas [S2]
The trophy unlocks after Chapter 4's first two main missions, Ocean Beach and Another Life [S1]

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Finish every mission of Chapter 4 in order. Before you start the chapter, clear the partner and one-off moment trophies flagged in Stage 4 of the roadmap if they are available to you — a chapter boundary is exactly where a cautious player banks a save and tidies loose ends, so nothing rides on the finale going perfectly.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — unlocks after the final main mission of Chapter 4 [S1].
steps: Play Chapter 4's missions in order — Child's Play, Headliners and VCIA Takedown sit in this chapter [S1]
The Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… unlocks large bank vault robberies [S1]
Bank the partner escapes before the chapter ends; they are cheaper now than after the finale [S1]
The trophy unlocks after Chapter 4's final main mission, Starting From Zero [S1]

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the final mission of the story — one of only two gold trophies, and the natural end of Stage 5. Do not start it until the roadmap's Stage 4 list is done or safely saved: partner escapes, stranger finals and the unique-moment trophies are all cheaper before the ending than after it. Keep a separate save slot untouched from before the finale so you can always go back.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status (the list's one hidden gold): GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — automatic on completing the final main mission; free-roam continues afterwards [S1].
steps: Finish the story's final main mission [S1]
Before starting it, keep one untouched save from before the finale [S3]
After the ending you return to free-roam, and the 100% checklist unlocks under Progress > Stats [S1][S3]
Nothing needed for 100% becomes unavailable after the story [S1]

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Finish the named mission Breakfast Run when the story offers it. Mission trophies like this one need completion only — no medal, no time and no no-damage condition is in the official wording — so play it clean and simple, and let it teach you the route rather than restarting for style points.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — unlocks during the Chapter 2 main mission Breakfast Run [S1].
steps: Reach Chapter 2 and accept the main mission Breakfast Run [S1]
Play it through to completion — automatic, cannot be missed [S1]
Completion is the whole requirement; no medal or time condition exists [S1][S3]

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Finish the named mission The Cartel Heist when the story offers it. A heist mission is also your rehearsal for the free-roam robbery trophies (bank vaults, an armoured truck, a jewellery store): note how the game handles entry, alarm and escape here, because Maximum Withdrawal and A Classic Blitz Play ask for the same loop outside a scripted mission.

steps: Reach Chapter 3 and accept the main mission The Cartel Heist [S1]
Play it through to completion — automatic, cannot be missed [S1]
Note its entry-alarm-escape loop; the free-roam robbery trophies reuse it [S1]

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the named mission Child's Play when the story offers it. Completion is the whole requirement in the official wording, so keep moving with the mission's own objectives and do not wander off for collectibles mid-mission — districts stay open afterwards, the mission state does not.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Child's Play [S1].

Play it through to completion — automatic, cannot be missed [S1]
Leave district collectibles until afterwards; the map stays open, the mission state does not [S1]

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Finish the named mission Headliners when the story offers it. As with every named-mission trophy in this list, the safe method is boring on purpose: accept the mission, follow its markers to the end, and only resume hunting counts and collectibles once the trophy has popped.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission Headliners [S1].
steps: Reach Chapter 4 and accept the main mission Headliners [S1]
Follow its markers to the end — automatic, cannot be missed [S1]
Resume count-hunting only once the trophy has popped [S2]

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Finish the named mission VCIA Takedown when the story offers it. VCIA is also the place named by Catch Me If You Can, so while this mission puts you there, learn the location's exits and layout — that knowledge is the whole preparation for the unscheduled-departure trophy later.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — unlocks during the Chapter 4 main mission VCIA Takedown; the departure trophy uses the planes at terminals E3/E4 [S1].

Play it through to completion — automatic, cannot be missed [S1]
While at VCIA, note the passenger planes docked at terminals E3/E4 for Catch Me If You Can [S1][S3]

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish the named mission Operation Savage Glory when the story offers it. Completion only, per the official wording. If a combat-heavy mission gives you trouble, the fix this guide recommends everywhere is the same: arrive stocked, use Combat Focus early rather than as a last resort, and keep one save from before the mission so a bad run costs minutes, not progress.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — unlocks during the Chapter 5 main mission Operation Savage Glory [S1].

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% game completion — the second gold, and the trophy this whole tracker exists to organise. Work it from the counts, not from memory: story chapters, 8 stranger strands, 250 stunts, 42 shooting-range golds, 18 meditation spots, 3 card sets, 100 WAiNK locations, 50 challenges and 52 areas are all tracked separately in this guide, and the game's own completion checklist is the referee. Leave this open until Stage 5, then close the last gaps district by district.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Method and thresholds: PowerPyx — the checklist is closer to 60% true completion, needs 200 of 277 vehicle scans, 100 of 255 animals studied, any 70 of 80 challenges and 100 optional missions [S1]; threshold table cross-checked in GAMES.GG [S3].

Close challenges at any 70 of 80 — you may skip the ten hardest [S1][S3]

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts, one of the biggest counts on the list. Do not grind these in one session: fold stunt jumps into normal driving from Chapter 3 on, and use the tracker count as your pace — roughly a district's worth each time you clear an area for The Goodtime State. A stunt only helps if it registers as complete, so land clean and wait for the confirmation before driving on.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — any 250 of 397 stunts across 130 stunt jumps, 202 under-the-bridge flights, 40 knife flights and 25 base jumps; 100% wants 300 [S1]; mix confirmed by GAMES.GG [S3].

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once — the starter list counts 9 activity types. This is the cheapest survey of Leonida you will ever get: do one of everything as it unlocks, note which ones you enjoy, and you will already know where the shooting range, drone races, fishing and arcade trophies live when Stage 3 starts in earnest. Trying counts; you do not need to win any of them for this one.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx names the 9 tracked types — fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race and a stunt — tracked under Touchpad > Progress > Activities [S1].

Do each once: fishing, hunting, golf, shooting ranges, pool, basketball, a video game, a race, a stunt [S1]

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — a silver that rewards patience, not speed. Learn one weapon family's challenges at a time and replay immediately while the targets are fresh in memory; a gold you nearly missed is a gold you understand. Save the hardest ranges for after the story, when nothing else is competing for your practice time.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx's linked guide covers all 12 shooting range locations and their 42 gold medals; all ranges are also required in full by the 100% checklist [S1].

items.where: 3 races — Draper Island Terminal (par 1:49), Draper Refinery East (1:44), Draper Refinery West (1:51)

items.name: Moreau Sawmill
items.where: 3 races — Abandoned Mining Pit (par 1:03), Adler Creek (1:21), Macalister Gold Mine (0:59)

items.name: Millport
items.where: 3 races — Millport (par 1:31), Rushwood Logging (2:08), Tallaloko Lakeside Resort (2:05)

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races — different is the word that matters, so replaying your favourite circuit twenty times earns nothing here. Spread wins across race types and districts, and pair each new race with the area exploration around it: the same trip can pay into this count, Whip It Good's vehicle discoveries and The Goodtime State's 52 areas at once.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx's linked guide lists 40 unique race locations, twice what the trophy needs [S1].
steps: Enter races across different districts and types — 40 unique race locations exist [S1]
Win 20 different ones; repeats of the same race do not add to the count [S2]
Pair each new race with vehicle scanning and area unfogging in the same trip [S1]
A won Top Fun drone race also counts as a race activity for Master of None [S1]

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal — the person named in the official description — in a fishing challenge. Fishing is introduced as an activity (see Master of None), so learn its timing there first, then take the challenge against Cal when you can already land catches reliably. If the challenge can be retried, treat a loss as practice information about what he catches, not as a failure state.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — after the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui (Meet Cal), Cal texts you and marks a fishing location with a purple icon; follow his fishing questline [S1].
steps: Play the Chapter 1 mission Feng Shui, where you meet Cal [S1]
Wait for Cal's text afterwards; it marks a fishing spot with a purple map icon [S1]
Learn fishing's timing first with a casual session (it also ticks Master of None) [S1]
Follow Cal's fishing questline and beat him in his challenge [S1]

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game, start to finish. Only one completion is required, so pick the arcade game you understand fastest rather than the first cabinet you find. This is a good palette-cleanser trophy: five quiet minutes of it between robbery runs resets your patience for the stealth and escape trophies.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx names the 4 video games — Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III, Time Jackers Rewind at the home TV from Chapter 1, and Bang For Your Buck at arcade machines [S1].
steps: From Chapter 1, use the TV at home and interact with the controllers to open the video games [S1]
Pick one of Tenebrae Lux, Street Trash III or Time Jackers Rewind (a fourth, Bang For Your Buck, sits at arcade machines) [S1]
Finish all of that game's levels at least once — challenges inside it are not required [S1]
Story sections can temporarily block the TV; it works again afterwards and after the story [S1]

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Andy — a strand ending this tracker flags as a caution because it ends a named person's questline. Round-2 research softens the worry: PowerPyx confirms Andy's quests remain available after the story, so the flag now means 'do not lose track of her', not 'she can vanish'. Note the correction the research forced: Andy's questline does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks — PowerPyx and GAMES.GG both separate the two.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — Lucia-only questline marked in Chapter 3, Andy calls, then texts her home address in Belville; 5 quests; still available after the story [S1].
steps: Play as Lucia in Chapter 3 until Andy's questline is marked automatically [S1]
Take Andy's call, then follow the home address she texts you in Belville [S1]
Complete her 5 quests: the three Climbing the Cellerichain parts, Pay the Cellerica Fee, Peach!, Read the Label and Puff Puff Pass [S1]
The trophy pops on the final quest; her strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks [S1][S3]

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Kenton, flagged as a caution in round 1 — and round-2 research is explicit that he is not missable: he becomes temporarily unavailable after Chapter 1, returns in Chapter 2–3, and all trophy quest givers are back after the story. Keep the flag as a reminder that his strand pauses mid-story, so a quiet Kenton icon is a pause, not a loss.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — questline marked in Chapter 1, green KR icon in Key Lento, 7 shipwreck treasure sets, tracked under Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees [S1].
steps: Work for Kenton in the Chapter 1 mission Island Dreams; he calls you afterwards [S1]
Find him under the green KR icon in Key Lento and accept his treasure-diving sets [S1]
Dive the purple treasure-chest icons, dig with the metal detector, and return each set to Kenton [S1]
Clear all 7 shipwrecks; if he goes quiet after Chapter 1, he returns in Chapter 2–3 — calling Brian as Jason speeds it up [S1]

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Billy, flagged as a caution as a named strand ending — with the round-2 correction that his quests, like the other strand finals, remain available after the story. Like Andy and Tyrone, Billy's questline does NOT count toward Strangers & Freaks, whatever round 1 implied; it is its own trophy and worth doing for itself.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — marked after the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break, at Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County; 5 quests; available after the story [S1].
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Coffee Break; Billy's questline is marked automatically [S1]
Go to Thrillbilly Mudclub in Kelly County [S1]
Complete his 5 quests: Thrillbillies, Twist Wrist Smash Grab, Mall Rats, The Impaler and Hometown Heroes [S1]
The trophy pops on the final quest; the strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks [S1][S3]

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 whole mission strands for strangers across Leonida — strands, not single missions, which is why this is silver. Round 2 corrects round 1's biggest error: the named trophy questlines (Andy, Billy, Tyrone, Moses and others) do NOT count as strangers here. PowerPyx names the strands confirmed to count — Kirk's Skunk Ape hunt, Kyle, Yago and Pilot Pete among them — and the game's own trophy tracker is the referee, so check it rather than counting contacts.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method and correction: PowerPyx lists the confirmed counting strands (Kirk, Kyle, Yago, Pilot Pete) and warns many optional questlines do not count [S1]; GAMES.GG repeats that Andy, Billy and Tyrone do not count [S3].
steps: Use the trophy tracker in the trophy list to see how many strands have actually counted [S1]
Prioritise the confirmed strands: Kirk (Search for the Skunk Ape, Tree Effigies, Mr. Mangrove) [S1]
Work Kyle's strand (McKittrick Farm, Collect Chemicals, Buddy?) and Yago's racing strand [S1]
Work Pilot Pete's strand (The Last Mile parts and his delivery runs) [S1]
Do not count Andy, Billy, Tyrone or Moses toward the 8 — their questlines are separate trophies [S1][S3]
All strangers remain findable after the story in free-roam [S1]

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Randy, flagged as a caution as a named strand ending — and, as with the other strands, PowerPyx confirms it can still be done after the story. His 'final mission' is really the end of a shopping list: 16 named sports cars delivered one by one, so the tracker count that matters is cars delivered, not missions played.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — Randy's Wish List opens in the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS; 16 sports cars; green RK icon in the west of Vice City [S1].
steps: Play the Chapter 3 mission Clonin' Keys, Makin' GS to unlock the Key Cloner and meet Randy's list [S1]
Open Map > Robberies > Randy's Wish List and work its 16 sports cars [S1]
Scan high-end cars with the WAiNK app to check them against the list; Vice Beach and Ocean Beach hotels are rich hunting [S1]
Deliver each car to Randy's garage (green RK icon, west Vice City) in good condition for better pay [S1]
Delivering the full list completes his final mission and pops the trophy [S1]

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Complete the final mission for Tyrone, flagged as a caution with the other strand endings — research again confirms it stays available after the story. It is Jason-only work: a short, loud strand about shutting down synthetic labs, and like Andy and Billy it does not count toward Strangers & Freaks.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — Jason-only, marked after the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty; destroy the Synthetic Labs, then Tyrone's second quest Spin On This unlocks the trophy [S1].
steps: Play as Jason and finish the Chapter 3 mission Here, Kitty Kitty [S1]
Follow the purple Synthetic Labs markers in Vice City and destroy the labs (Take Out Kitty Litter) [S1]
After enough labs are down, take Tyrone's second quest, Spin On This [S1]
Finishing it pops the trophy; the strand does not count toward Strangers & Freaks [S1][S3]

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every spot across Leonida — 18 spots, and the one trophy the fetched sources agree can actually be missed. The risk is a single early moment: during Chapter 1, after Down to Earth, Lucia talks about meditating at Jason's house and walks to the balcony. Accept, or that meditation is gone for the run (whether the trophy strictly needs it is still unconfirmed — both PowerPyx and GAMES.GG say not to gamble). Everywhere else the method is geographic: meditate as both characters where you can, since a spot done with Jason and Lucia counts twice.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Missable warning and balcony method: PowerPyx — the game's one potentially missable trophy [S1]; GAMES.GG's roadmap repeats the Chapter 1 warning and the unconfirmed status [S3].
steps: ⚠ In Chapter 1, the morning after Down to Earth, talk to Lucia in Jason's kitchen when she mentions meditating [S1][S3]
Follow her to the balcony and choose Accept — this meditation is permanently unavailable after Chapter 1 [S1][S3]
Meditate at the 18 spots across 10 locations; a spot used by both Jason and Lucia counts as +2 [S1]
Track progress under Progress > Collections > Exploration > Meditations [S1]
The final spot needs both characters playable together, unlocked after Chapter 2's Coffee Break [S1]
For the 100% checklist only 15 of 18 are needed — the trophy wants all 18 [S1]
Use the spot-by-spot checklist below — it names all 10 spots with their counties, from the Chapter 1 balcony to Ascent Mountain, the final spot that is only marked after the rest are done [S5]
trophies.items_note: 10 spots, 18 meditations: spots 2–9 count twice (once with each character), the balcony and the finale count once. Ticking a spot adds its meditations to YOUR COUNT above [S5].

items.name: Jason's House Meditation

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret — the word unique is why this carries a caution flag: there is, by the official wording, one such animal, tied to one named person. When Bret's hunt opens, do it then, and save before you set out. Do not treat it as background hunting; it is a named commission with a single target, and this guide banks commissions before finales.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — Bret Vogel's Jason-only questline starts with his text after Coffee Break; Veteran Hunted in Lummox County; 15 Target Decks for 100% [S1].
steps: Play as Jason after Chapter 2's Coffee Break and wait for Bret Vogel's text [S1]
Start Veteran Hunted (Meet Bret) in Lummox County — Lucia cannot receive the message [S1]
Take the unique hunting rifle Killtelligence SM-69 from any Ammu-Nation weapon locker [S1]
Follow Bret's purple hunting markers and bring him the animals he requests [S1]
Work his Target Decks (tracked under Map > Activities > Target Deck); the unique-animal hunt sits inside this questline [S1]

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets — a set only counts when it is whole, so think in sets, not in loose cards. Pick up every card you pass from the first hour (cards are cheapest when the trip was happening anyway), then in Stage 3 choose the three sets nearest completion and close those, district by district. Chasing a fourth set before the third is finished is how this silver stalls.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx's linked guide covers all 18 collectible card set locations — the trophy needs any 3 complete sets of the 18 [S1].
steps: Pick up cards whenever a trip passes one; loose cards only pay off inside a finished set [S2]
Choose the three sets nearest completion out of the 18 that exist [S1]
Close those sets district by district before starting a fourth [S1]
The third completed set pops the trophy [S2]
Pick your three sets from the full list below — all 18 sets with their card counts; the smallest, Backyard Wrestling, holds just 12 cards [S8]
trophies.items_note: All 18 sets with their card counts — 480 unique cards in total. The trophy needs any 3 complete sets; the 100% checklist wants 15 of 18, at least 372 cards [S8][S10].

items.name: Backyard Wrestling
items.where: 12-card set — the smallest set in the game

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 locations — the second-largest count on the list after the 250 stunts. It is a silver because of volume, not difficulty, so the method is routing: never cross a district for a story mission without checking the map for unvisited WAiNK locations on the way. If you start this only in the endgame it is a slog; started in Chapter 2 it mostly completes itself.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — scan with hold-up + R1; the scannables are 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures and No Flusher Tags, and more than 100 exist [S1].
steps: Scan environmental objects with the WAiNK app (hold up, then R1) whenever you pass one [S1]
Hunt by category: 31 landmarks, 35 curiosities, 23 sculptures, plus No Flusher Tags [S1]
Any 100 will do — there are more than 100 in the world, so never backtrack for one specific spot [S1]
Keep environmental scans separate from vehicle scans in your notes; they are different counters [S3]
Start with the 7 landmarks already published in the checklist below — and note that AHOL Street Art and 1010 Murals scan the same way but do not count toward this trophy [S11][S12]
trophies.items_note: Only 7 of the 31 landmarks were named when the source list was fetched — it is a work in progress, so this checklist is the published part, not the whole set. The other published WAiNK sets hold 35 curiosities and 23 sculptures, plus the No Flusher Tags [S11][S12].

items.name: Farmer Scrumpy's Apple Orchard
items.where: Kelly County > Manifest Canyon — Landmark #6 of 31

items.name: Gellhorn Fun Fair
items.where: Kelly County > Port Gellhorn — Landmark #11 of 31

items.name: Kalaga Lookout
items.where: Lummox County > Mount Kalaga National Park — Landmark #18 of 31

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges, of any mix the game offers. Challenges overlap almost everything else in Stage 3 — races, ranges, stunts and activities all feed the same pool of things to try — so check this count before starting a dedicated grind; most players who worked the roadmap in order find they are closer than they thought. Finish the last few with the shortest challenges you have left, not the most glamorous.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — 80 challenges exist, 50 earns this trophy and any 70 of 80 is what 100% requires, so this pops automatically on the road to A Long Road [S1][S3].
steps: Track challenges under Progress > Challenges and check the Completed marks [S1]
Let normal trophy work fill the pool — most challenges complete without trying [S1]
Leave this late: at the end, pick the easiest and quickest challenges you have left [S1]
The 50th completed challenge pops it; keep going to 70 only for the 100% checklist [S1][S3]

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner beside you, earn a 4-star wanted level, then lose it and escape — both halves, together, are the trophy. It is flagged as a caution because it depends on your partner, and partner availability is a story state: do it in Stage 4, before the finale, not after. Plan the escape before you earn the stars: know your hiding terrain, break line of sight early, and stay out of sight until the level clears rather than racing the whole map at full heat.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — possible from Coffee Break on; the train tunnel north of Ambrosia (Kelly County) breaks helicopter sight; it also comes automatically during large bank vault robberies [S1]; heat-zone rule confirmed by GAMES.GG [S3].
steps: Unlock partner free-roam by finishing Chapter 2's Coffee Break, then call your partner (hold right + triangle) [S1]
Cause enough carnage together to reach a 4-star wanted level [S1]
Escape on a fast motorcycle and break line of sight; shoot down a pursuing helicopter if it pins you [S1]
Use the train tunnel north of Ambrosia in Kelly County — police struggle on the tracks and helicopters cannot see in [S1][S3]
The trophy pops when you leave the red heat zone, not merely the flashing search area [S1][S3]

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, keeping your wanted level the whole run — the mirror image of Hot Together, and flagged as a caution for the same partner reason. Choose three shops close together before you start, move straight between them with no detours, and resist a fourth: the trophy needs the chain of three intact, and greed after the third shop is the usual way the chain, and the wanted level, breaks.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — after Coffee Break; rob targets at the 3 jewellery stores in the north of Vice City (after Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs); the unlock can lag ~30 seconds [S1]; keep the flashing pursuit, not just the heat zone [S3].
steps: From Coffee Break on, call your partner (hold right + triangle) and stock an armoured vest, sticky bombs and healing [S1]
Pick three close robbery targets — the 3 jewellery stores in north Vice City work once Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs is done [S1]
Rob items in each store and crack the back-room safe so each robbery fully registers [S1]
Move straight to the next store while the red/blue flashing wanted level stays active [S1][S3]
Wait before judging failure — the trophy can pop about 30 seconds after the third shop [S1][S3]

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 different vehicles. Discovery rewards variety, so change cars often instead of marrying one favourite: every new district, car park and traffic mix is a handful of discoveries waiting. Pair this with On the Spot — vehicles you register in the Scooter Bros app are vehicles you have found — and with race wins, where the game's own fleet does the variety for you.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — discovery means WAiNK-scanning vehicles (557 at launch); stand at a busy road and scan traffic; check totals under Progress > Vehicles [S1].
steps: Scan new vehicles with the WAiNK app (hold up, then R1) — scanning is enough, driving is not required [S1]
Stand at a busy road and scan passing traffic for fast early discoveries [S1]
Check your totals under Touchpad > Progress > Vehicles by category [S1]
The 100th discovered vehicle pops it; 100% will later ask for 200 of 277 base models [S1]

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies inside one single use of Combat Focus — the count and the single-use limit are both in the official wording, so this is about setup, not aim. Wait for a moment when at least five enemies are already in front of you, trigger Combat Focus once, and work nearest to farthest without pausing to loot or reload your plan mid-flow. If a run ends at four, you set up too early, not too late.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — Combat Focus is L3+R3 while aiming; adrenaline extends it; line up criminals at gang operations with an assault rifle; it does not work on police, soldiers or civilians [S1][S3].
steps: Buff your focus first: eat, drink, wash or shower, and take adrenaline to extend the bar [S1]
Find a clustered group of at least five criminals — gang operations are ideal [S1][S3]
Aim and press L3+R3 once to enter Combat Focus [S1][S3]
Drop all five inside that single use, nearest first, with a full-auto assault rifle [S1]
It gets easier at Focus Level 4, raised by shooting ranges, golf, pool, fishing and headshots [S1]

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA — VCIA is the place the official description names, and the same place the mission VCIA Takedown (Hi-Jacked) takes you to. Flagged as a caution because it is one described moment at one named place: when you are at VCIA outside a scripted departure, experiment with leaving on your own terms instead of following the scheduled route, and save before you try so an attempt costs nothing.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx — steal a bridge-docked passenger plane at terminals E3/E4, take off and fly about 1 km away [S1][S3].
steps: Go to VCIA (Vice City International Airport) and find the passenger plane docked at departure terminals E3/E4 [S1][S3]
Enter through the stairs beside the boarding bridge (or through the terminal on foot); airfield planes do not work [S1][S3]
Go upstairs to the cockpit, reverse the plane back to the airstrip and take off [S1]
Fly about 1 km (0.6 miles) away from the airport — the unlock is delayed until then [S1][S3]

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The official description is a joke with a vehicle in it: Rhinos — the series' tanks. Treat this as a caution-flagged encounter trophy: when Rhinos are in front of you in the story, engage with that moment instead of avoiding it, and keep a save from before any set-piece involving them. Because PlayStation's wording hides the exact trigger, this guide claims no more than the description supports: be present, be in the fight, and do not drive past the tanks.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method (round-2 upgrade — round 1 had none): PowerPyx — steal a tank at Mile Zero Air Station, Mariana County, and shoot enemies until it unlocks [S1].
steps: Travel to Mile Zero Air Station, the island at the south-west edge of the map in Mariana County [S1]
The tanks stand in the south of the air base; enter through the gate or the stunt jump by the south-east entrance [S1]
Get in a Rhino tank [S1]
Shoot enemies with it until the trophy unlocks [S1]

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewellery store without being detected — detection, not speed, is the fail state, so plan like a burglar: scout the store's sightlines in daylight, enter quietly, take what the robbery needs and leave by the calmest exit. The Cartel Heist mission is your rehearsal for how the game reads alarms; a detected attempt still teaches the layout, and the store will still be there tomorrow, which is why this one carries no caution flag.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — finish Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs (Chapter 3) for the Snap Gun, enter by the back door, find the safe-code note; Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is the suggested store [S1][S3].
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Yasmani's Jewelry Jobs to unlock jewellery robberies and the Snap Gun [S1][S3]
Pick a marked store (green icon) — Richardson Jewelry & Diamonds in Vice City is a proven target [S1][S3]
Enter through the back door with the Snap Gun; kicking the door triggers the alarm [S1][S3]
Find the note with the safe code inside, loot the safe, and leave undetected [S1]

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 bank vaults and escape after each one — five full loops of entry, vault, exit and escape, which is why it is silver. Learn the loop on the first vault with no heroics, then repeat it with better routes. An escape only counts when you are actually clear, so finish the getaway before you celebrate; Hot Together's line-of-sight discipline is the same skill, used five times.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — unlocked by the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is…; 8 large bank jobs exist, all 8 needed for 100%; vaults pay up to $205,000 [S1]; partner carries a cash bag [S3].
steps: Finish the Chapter 4 optional mission That's Where The Money Is… to unlock vault robberies and do the first one [S1]
Afterwards, pay Yasmani for security-van tips ($10,000) once his earlier quests are done, and follow the purple-marked vans [S1]
Enter while the guard has the vault open and bring your partner — you cannot carry all the cash alone [S1][S3]
Escape the 4-star wanted level on a fast motorcycle, then switch vehicles to become unrecognisable [S1]
Repeat at any 5 of the 8 large banks; all 8 are needed later for 100% [S1]

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob one armoured truck and escape. One truck, one escape: pick your moment when you meet one in free roam rather than hunting the map, strike where your getaway route is already clear, and leave the moment the robbery is done. It pairs naturally with Maximum Withdrawal — same entry-and-escape discipline, smaller stage — so do it during the Stage 4 crime sweep.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — a large bank vault robbery counts as robbing the armoured truck automatically; the early method is a sticky bomb on a truck's back door, then escape the red heat radius [S1].
steps: Easiest route: do any large bank vault robbery — tailing its armoured truck counts for this trophy automatically [S1]
Early route: find an armoured truck near a Vice City bank, block its path and blow the back door with a sticky bomb [S1]
Sticky bombs are in the back of Yasmani's shop after his Chapter 3 quests [S1]
Either way, the trophy only pops after you escape the red heat radius (or use a Pay 'n' Spray) [S1][S3]

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida — 52 areas on the tracked list. Exploration trophies are won by routing, not by wandering: uncover the map district by district, and never make a trip that only pays this one count. Every district sweep in this roadmap is built to stack — areas here, meditation spots, WAiNK locations, cards, stunts and vehicles all in the same drive — so by Stage 3's end the map, and this trophy, should simply be done.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Area count: the tracked count as listed in round 1's sources. Method (round-2 upgrade): PowerPyx — fully unfog the whole map, best done by plane [S1].
steps: Take a plane and fly over every black-fogged part of the map until it is all visible [S1]
Work district by district so each flight also passes stunt, scan and card locations [S2]
Check the map for leftover fog pockets after each sweep [S1]
A fully unfogged map across all 52 tracked areas pops the trophy [S2]

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an illegal operation belonging to each gang — the tracked list counts 9 gangs, and each gang counts once, so variety is the requirement again. Keep a written tally of which gangs you have hit; robbing the same gang's operation three times feels like progress and is not. Spread these across Stage 4 so each robbery also rehearses the vault and truck escapes.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — 9 gangs and 39 illegal operations in total, marked with yellow icons; track per-gang progress under Progress > Gangs [S1]; all 39 needed for 100% [S3].
steps: Find illegal operations — they are marked with yellow icons when you come near, and many are marked by story progress [S1]
Rob one operation belonging to each of the 9 gangs [S1][S3]
Track which gangs you have covered under Progress > Gangs, bottom-right count per gang [S1]
One per gang pops the trophy; all 39 operations are a separate 100% requirement [S1][S3]

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach — the place is named in the official description, and the name is published with its ellipsis, exactly as shown here. Flagged as a caution because it is a single described moment: early in the game, when Ocean Beach is in front of you, stop, take the cocktail moment the game offers there, and let the quietest trophy on the list be the first one you bank. It costs minutes in Stage 1 and saves regret in Stage 5.
trophies.sources: Official name (ellipsis as published) and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — this guide asserts no trigger beyond the official description [S1].
steps: Go to Ocean Beach, the place the official description names [S2]
Look for the cocktail moment the game offers there, with the view [S2]
Honest status: PowerPyx lists the exact trigger as currently unknown, so experiment on site and save first [S1]
It is hidden on PSN until earned, so do not expect it in your visible list [S3]

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom, in the classic style the description asks for — meaning out through the glass, in a vehicle, not out the door on foot. Flagged as a caution as a single described moment: when a mission or your own curiosity puts you inside a showroom with a car, take the loud exit. Save beforehand if you are improvising it in free roam, so a failed attempt is a reload, not a repair bill of consequences.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx lists this trophy as currently unknown — the steps below are only what the official description itself supports [S1].
steps: Find yourself inside a vehicle showroom with a usable vehicle [S2]
Drive out through the glass frontage rather than leaving on foot — that is the 'classic style' the description asks for [S2]
Honest status: PowerPyx lists the exact trigger as currently unknown, so save before experimenting [S1]
It is hidden on PSN until earned [S3]

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Play the bowling at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley — the alley is named in the official description, apostrophe and all, exactly as PlayStation publishes the trophy name. Bowling is an activity, so it also belongs to your Master of None survey; the description's 'follow-through' is the joke and the instruction at once: play a real game there, do not just walk in and out. Not to be confused with Ten Pin, which uses bowling only as a metaphor.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method (round-2 correction — it is a robbery, not a bowling game): PowerPyx — steal all 3 key valuables at Kingpin Bowling, Port Gellhorn, a gang operation visited in the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling [S1][S3].
steps: Buy sticky bombs at an Ammu-Nation first — you need them for the safe [S1][S3]
Go to Kingpin Bowling in Port Gellhorn, marked during the Chapter 2 optional mission Hit Kingpin Bowling [S1]
Steal the luxury watch in the south-east office [S1][S3]
Steal the Gutterball Moreland 850 shotgun on the table in the north-east corner [S1][S3]
Blow the safe in the north-east hallway office with sticky bombs and loot it [S1][S3]
Escape the police — the trophy pops after the escape, and any missed valuable can be collected on a later visit [S1]

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: The official description is deliberately coy — a partnership with mass appeal — and names no place and no count, so this guide asserts neither. It is flagged as a caution because its wording points at your partnership: spend time doing things together with your partner in public, in Stage 4 before the finale, rather than treating your partner as a mission-only passenger. When a shared moment draws a crowd's attention, you are in the territory the description describes; save often while you experiment.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method (round-2 upgrade — round 1 had none): PowerPyx — reach maximum Strength with both Jason and Lucia at the same time, training together at fitness clubs [S1][S3].
steps: From Chapter 2's Coffee Break on, you can switch between Jason and Lucia [S1]
Check Strength under Touchpad > Jason & Lucia > select character (heart icon) [S1]
Call your partner (hold right + triangle) and work out together at fitness clubs — the inactive partner trains too, doubling progress [S1][S3]
Filter the map for fitness clubs under Activities (dumbbell icon) [S1]
Maximum Strength on both characters at the same time pops the trophy [S1]

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices — PlayStation tracks this one to a count of 500, the largest number attached to any trophy here. Flagged as a caution because choices are made inside moments that pass: never skip a decision the game offers you, and do not reload away a choice just because it went badly, since the description itself says 'for better or worse'. A player who answers every prompt the game makes will build this count naturally across the story; a player who avoids decisions starves it.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method (round-2 precision): PowerPyx — the 500 are actions that affect your Criminal Profile; turn on Criminal Profile notifications in Settings > UI to watch them land [S1].
steps: Turn on Criminal Profile notifications (Settings > UI > HUD Notifications > Criminal Profile = On) [S1]
Play normally — robberies, stealthy escapes, evidence destruction and enemy encounters all move the profile [S1][S3]
Watch the demon-face notification on the right of the screen to confirm an action counted [S1]
Check your total by selecting the trophy in the trophy list [S1]
Leave this until last if it is short — it accrues passively through all other trophy work [S3]

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second try — the description's joke is the method: something must be attempted, failed or missed, and then done again successfully. Flagged as a caution because it needs a specific retry-shaped moment: when the game offers you a second attempt at something, take it in the same sitting rather than postponing it, and do not reload a save to erase a first failure before the retry can happen — the failure is half the trophy.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed related to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue — unconfirmed, and labelled as such here [S1].
steps: Honest status: no fetched source confirms the trigger yet [S1]
PowerPyx's belief, unconfirmed: it relates to the Payday Loans store from the Prologue [S1]
When the game offers a second attempt at something, take it in the same sitting [S2]
Do not reload away a first failure before the retry can happen [S2]

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness something strange — the description is a reaction, not an instruction, so this guide claims no location for it. Flagged as a caution because strange events are, by nature, single moments: explore Leonida's quiet corners during the Stage 3 sweeps instead of only its mission markers, and when something odd starts happening near you, stay and watch it finish rather than driving on. Curiosity is the whole strategy the sources support.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be from a UFO questline — unconfirmed, and labelled as such here [S1].
steps: Honest status: no fetched source confirms the trigger yet [S1]
PowerPyx's belief, unconfirmed: it belongs to a UFO questline [S1]
Explore beyond mission markers during the Stage 3 sweeps and stay to watch strange events finish [S2]
It is hidden on PSN until earned [S3]

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down with a melee drive-by — bowling here is only the metaphor in the description (the real bowling alley belongs to Let's Go Bowling). Ride or drive past a target at close range and use the melee attack from the vehicle as you pass; the hit must land from the moving vehicle to be a drive-by. Practise the timing on a quiet street first, because at speed the window is short and a miss is just traffic.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Hidden status: GAMES.GG [S3]. Method: PowerPyx lists it as currently unknown, believed to be kicking enemies while driving a motorcycle — unconfirmed, and labelled as such here [S1].
steps: Honest status: no fetched source confirms the trigger yet [S1]
PowerPyx's belief, unconfirmed: kicking enemies while riding a motorcycle [S1]
Ride past a target at close range and use the melee attack from the moving vehicle [S2]
Practise the timing on a quiet street first; the window at speed is short [S2]

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 by laundering Marked Bills through your contacts — a money total, tracked in dollars, not a single big score. Route your marked bills to your contacts as a habit from the moment the option exists, rather than stockpiling them for one Stage 5 panic. Every robbery in Stage 4 can feed this total, so run the crime sweep and the laundering together and the quarter-million arrives as bookkeeping, not as a grind.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and total: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — the Dye Pack Jammer unlocks in the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check; deliver marked bills to a fence (Yasmani pays most); bank vaults give up to $205,000 each [S1].
steps: Finish the Chapter 3 mission Credit Check (Meet Raul's Crew) to unlock the Dye Pack Jammer [S1]
Rob banks and Payday Loans to obtain marked bills [S1]
Deliver the bills to a fence — Yasmani in Vice City pays the most [S1]
The total is cumulative across all robberies; it does not need one delivery [S1]
Late game, bank vault robberies (up to $205,000 each) close the gap fast [S1]

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops — across all of them, in total, so ordinary play does most of this: stock, clothes, services and garages all spend into the same pot. Do not waste money early just to chase it; check the tracker in Stage 3, and if a gap remains, spend it on things the other trophies need anyway, like the garage properties of Little Boxes. Money spent with a second purpose is never wasted.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and total: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — spending counts across all shop types (24 Ammu-Nations, 67 clothing stores, 11 tattoo studios and more); guns, car mods and tattoos are the fastest spend [S1].
steps: Spend normally as you play — every shop type counts toward the one total [S1]
If a gap remains, buy guns, car mods and tattoos, the most expensive categories [S1]
Garage purchases for Little Boxes ($160,000 in total) overshoot this target on their own [S1]
The $100,000th dollar spent across shops pops the trophy [S2]

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all 8 garage properties. This is a purchase checklist, so it is gated by money, not by skill: earn first (the Stage 4 robberies and Dime on the Dollar's laundering both pay), then buy garages district by district as you clear them, and count them off — eight is few enough that a written tally ends all doubt. Every garage purchase also spends into Treat Yo Self's $100,000.
trophies.sources: Official name and description: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — 8 purchasable garages (4 more are story-given), $160,000 total, bought in the Vice City Real Estate phone app after the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver [S1][S3].
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Daily Driver; the Vice City Real Estate app is installed on your phone [S1][S3]
Raise $160,000 — robberies in Chapters 3–4 are the quick way [S1]
Buy all 8 purchasable garages through the phone app; the 4 story garages do not count [S1][S3]
The eighth purchase pops the trophy, and the spend also completes Treat Yo Self [S1]

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app — the app and the count are both in the official description. Register vehicles as you discover them for Whip It Good, choosing different vehicles each time, and this finishes early almost by accident: ten registrations against a hundred discoveries means every tenth new vehicle just needs remembering. If you reach 100 discoveries with this unfinished, you simply never opened the app — open it.
trophies.sources: Official name, description and count: Exophase [S2]. Method: PowerPyx — the app arrives in the Chapter 2 mission Moses; drive stolen vehicles to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register; garages provide the parking spots [S1][S3].
steps: Finish the Chapter 2 mission Moses (Take A Vehicle to Moses) to install the Scooter Bros app [S1][S3]
Buy garages first if you lack parking spots — each garage adds registration capacity [S1]
Drive a stolen vehicle to Moses in Port Gellhorn and choose Respray, then Register [S1][S3]
Use cheap low-end cars and bikes to keep registration costs down [S1]
Early on only tracker-free vehicles are accepted; from Chapter 3, Standard Tracker cars and Pay 'n' Spray registration work too [S1]
